project: What a Log Actually Is (full video)
rule: Every number shown or spoken must match this sheet. Use fact_check.py before rendering.

facts.claim: Layers after n folds = 2^n (1..5 -> 2,4,8,16,32)
Doubling x adds exactly 1 to log2(x)
Log ruler 1..10: 1->2 is 30.1% of length; 9->10 is 4.6%
Steady growth: 1,000->2,000 takes 6.58x as long as 9,000->10,000 (any growth rate) -> say 'more than six times'
Earthquake: +1 magnitude = 10x amplitude (USGS), ~32x energy (10^1.5=31.6); M7 vs M5 = 100x amplitude
facts.source: USGS: each whole number = tenfold measured amplitude, ~31-32x energy

facts.claim: pH 3 vs pH 6 = 1000x more acidic (10 per step)
Sound: +10 dB = 10x intensity. Whisper ~30 dB, jet ~140 dB up close; gap 110 dB = 10^11 = 100,000,000,000x
facts.source: physics classroom / NIDCD; levels are approximate

facts.claim: Moon avg distance 384,400 km; ratio to 0.1 mm paper = 3.844e12 ('about 3.8 trillion')
Thickness ladder (0.1 mm paper): 10 folds=102.4 mm, 20=104.9 m, 30=107.4 km, 40=109,951 km
41 folds = 219,902 km (short of Moon); 42 folds = 439,805 km (past Moon); minimum n = 42
